messages:
morgan: heads-up — I found a leak between the eval holdout and the training prompt bank used for the recent quantization smoke. reproducer attached below.

morgan: steps i ran: 1) checkout `quant-smoke/2026-04` 2) sample holdout via `scripts/sample_holdout.py --seed 42` 3) fingerprinted prompts with `sha1` and compared to train set - 212 overlaps out of 12k.

morgan: example diff:```
- train: 'How do I reset my password on Acme?'  (id: a1b2c3)
+ holdout: 'how can I reset my password on Acme?' (id: d4e5f6)
```

morgan: looks like light paraphrases slipped past our de-dupe heuristics (case/ punctuation). this matters because the quantization bench showed small but consistent perf wins on the holdout vs training, probably optimistic.

tina: ouch. how confident are we this is systemic vs a small sampling fluke? :thinking_face:

morgan: ran fuzzy dedupe with trigram jaccard @0.85 threshold — overlaps are real paraphrase pairs, not just stopword diffs. i spot-checked 50 pairs, ~80% are near-duplicates.

ben: +1 freeze the current quant smoke results from being used in reports. can we mark the benchmark as tainted? open an issue?

alice: tagging as tainted and creating a short postmortem would be good. also need to coordinate labeler re-runs for any queries that were in the holdout. sam, can ops help with rerun window? @sam

sam: I can spin a dedicated job pool for relabels. ETA ~2.5hrs to warm GPUs. how many items?

morgan: ~12k holdout rows. but only ~212 dup clusters to be removed, then we should resample an extra 3% to maintain distribution.

labeler-bot: queued 12,000 tasks into labeler-v2 project `quant-holdout-relabel`. estimated throughput: 800/hr with current staffing.

ben: plan suggestion: 1) mark current quant run as tainted in docs and Slack threads 2) run deterministic dedupe pass with canonicalization (lowercase, strip punctuation, canonical date formats) 3) remove near-duplicates and resample holdout to target size 4) re-run internal evals + quant smoke 5) note delta and update benchmark PR.

alice: agree. for step 2 let's use the updated dedupe config i pushed to `infra/dedupe/configs/2026-04.json` earlier — it handles contractions and unicode normalization. here's the CLI i used:```
python infra/dedupe/run.py --input prompts.json --method fuzzy --threshold 0.85 --normalize unicode,lower,punct
```

alice: i'll open a short ticket with checklist and assign owners. morgan, can you add a small sample report with before/after metric diffs once we rerun?

morgan: yep. i'll produce a before/after table and a minimal eval summary (perplexity, exact-match on labeled spans, and the quantization throughput/loss numbers).

tina: do we need to notify any customers or is this internal?

ben: internal for now — results haven't been published externally. notify PMs that rely on these bench numbers (cc @pm-infra) once we have the rerun.

devex-bot: CI: test/quant-smoke build queued (job #7845). Logs: https://ci.internal/7845

morgan: note on sampling: let's bias resampling towards lower-frequency intents; the dup pairs are concentrated in high-frequency support prompts, we want holdout to represent tail cases better. i'll add the `intent_weight` adjustments to the sampler.

sam: relabel job pool is ready, starting warm-up now. expected to begin labeler ingestion in ~30m.

labeler-bot: labeler-v2 project updated: added reviewers [alice, ben], priority: high.

alice: timeline check — target to have new quant-smoke rerun and initial report within 12 hours?

morgan: yes that's doable if relabelers clear the high-priority queue. i'll try to produce a preliminary diff within 6 hours.

ben: thanks all. can someone drop a short note in the benchmarking doc and set the README status to "tainted — re-run in progress"? small templates are under docs/bench/status-templates.md.

alice: done — updated README status and added link to this thread. :white_check_mark:

tina: great. ping when the rerun artifacts are uploaded.

morgan: will do. created internal ticket: https://tickets.internal/RED-4123 — tracking dedupe -> resample -> rerun -> report.

ben: closing loop: after rerun, we should add an automated fuzzy-dedupe gate into the eval pipeline so future holdouts fail CI if overlap >0.1%. can we add that as a follow-up?

alice: +1, added to ticket as follow-up step.

morgan: thanks everyone, i'll post updates here as stages complete. :rocket:
